title: Carriage of a Device to the Dock on Northbeam Renew Trade-In, and What Is Charged or Relieved
content:
**Carriage.** A device traded under Northbeam Renew Trade-In reaches the retailer by a way the Renew programme allows, and a prepaid label stays usable for the programme's label validity days from the day it is issued.

**The state in which a fee may be touched.** A handling or freight fee is charged or waived only while the agreement stands accepted, device received, appraised or credited. The state is read from the trade-in agreement record itself, matched by the agreement's own reference number, and it is read before the charge or the waiver is booked; the customer's account of where the device has got to is not the authority here.

| Agreement stands | A handling or freight fee may be charged or waived |
| --- | --- |
| quoted | no |
| accepted | yes |
| device received | yes |
| appraised | yes |
| credited | yes |
| declined | no |
| expired | no |
| returned to the customer | no |

**Charging for carriage.** The sentence *The programme's handling fee is charged on a mailed-in device and is waived where the quote is at or above the programme's waiver figure; the freight fee is charged on a palletised collection, which needs the programme's lead days of notice* is **no longer in force**. What a palletised collection is charged, and on what it turns, is settled on the current basis for the Renew programme concerned; the figures the programme publishes for the handling of a mailed-in device, for its waiver and for the collection of a palletised batch stand as published figures of the programme.

**Loss, damage and short shipments.**

- A device lost or damaged on the way in is settled up to the programme's transit cover figure, and the customer is not asked to prove the value beyond the quote already written.
- A shipment arriving with fewer units than the request declared is booked in at the units actually received, and the agreement is appraised on those.

**Sending a declined device back.** A declined device is sent back within the programme's return days, carried by whoever the programme's return shipping basis names.

the freight fee is charged on a palletised collection, which needs the programme's lead days of notice
